By occasion · Seemantham

Seemantham catering menus

A seemantham is a daytime function, so the spread is tiffin-led — a sweet to start, then idli, dosai, pongal and vadai with chutney and sambar, with the full banana-leaf sappadu for families who seat their guests for lunch. Every set in our seemantham list is a tiffin or a lunch spread; none is a dinner. From 30 guests for a tiffin spread and 50 for a full sappadu, and every set is customisable, including Jain and no onion-garlic.

14 sets · every dish listed below · all customisable, including Jain and no onion-garlic.
